# Maratha Matrimony (मराठा लागीन / Maratha Lageen)

> Karnataka & Maharashtra Premier Matrimonial & Matchmaking Network for the Maratha Community.

## Summary
Maratha Matrimony (Maratha Lageen - https://marathalageen.com) is Karnataka exclusively dedicated matrimonial platform designed specifically for Maratha families, including 96 Kuli Maratha (९६ कुळी मराठा), Kunbi Maratha (कुणबी मराठा), Deshastha Maratha (देशस्थ मराठा), and Kshatriya Maratha (क्षत्रಿಯ ಮರಾಠ). The platform features authentic Devak (देवक) alignment, Gotra lineage verification, 36 Gunas Vedic Kundali matching, and state-of-the-art candidate privacy shields.

## Core Features
- **Lineage & Devak Compatibility**: Rigorous checking of traditional Devak clans and Gotra exclusions (Sagotra vivah restrictions) to recommend culturally harmonious alliances.
- **36 Gunas Vedic Kundali Milan**: Instant horoscope matching with Rashi, Nakshatra, Gan, Nadi, and Manglik dosha calculations.
- **Privacy Shield & Phone Masking**: Candidate contact details and photos are protected. Direct contacts are only unlocked upon mutual family interest and verification.
- **Early Bird VIP Membership**: Pre-registering families receive a complimentary ₹4,999 VIP Membership with unlimited verified biodatas and WhatsApp connects.
- **Regional Karnataka Focus**: Comprehensive presence across Belagavi, Bengaluru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Uttara Kannada, Vijayapura, Bagalkote, Bidar, Kalaburagi, and Kolhapur/Maharashtra border regions.
